# CLI: Volume

## attach-volume

Kind: Write.

Returns `Changed: false` if the volume is already attached to this server. Waits
up to five minutes to confirm attachment unless `--no-wait` is set.

| Flag          | Type     | Required |
| ------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--volume-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--server-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--no-wait`   | `bool`   |          |

```sh
greennode volume attach-volume --volume-id <volume-id> --server-id <server-id>
```

## create-volume

Kind: Write.

Checks the exact name through the volume inventory and quotes the order before
sending it. A quote must be positive and at most `--max-price`.

An uncertain order may have created a volume. Check the inventory for the exact
name before repeating the command.

| Flag                   | Type      | Required |
| ---------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--name`               | `string`  | yes      |
| `--zone-id`            | `string`  | yes      |
| `--size`               | `int`     | yes      |
| `--volume-type-id`     | `string`  | yes      |
| `--encryption-type-id` | `string`  |          |
| `--auto-renew`         | `bool`    |          |
| `--max-price`          | `float64` |          |
| `--no-wait`            | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode volume create-volume --name <name> --zone-id <zone-id> --size <size> --volume-type-id <volume-type-id>
```

## delete-volume

Kind: Write, destructive.

Requires `--yes` and a fresh read confirming the volume is detached. Deletion
destroys the volume's data.

Waits up to five minutes for `404` or `DELETED` unless `--no-wait` is set.

| Flag          | Type     | Required |
| ------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--volume-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--no-wait`   | `bool`   |          |

```sh
greennode volume delete-volume --volume-id <volume-id> --yes
```

## detach-volume

Kind: Write, destructive.

Requires `--yes`. Refuses to detach a boot volume or detach when the boot volume
cannot be confirmed.

`--allow-running` skips the stopped-server check. Unmount the volume before
detaching it from a running server.

| Flag              | Type     | Required |
| ----------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--volume-id`     | `string` | yes      |
| `--server-id`     | `string` | yes      |
| `--allow-running` | `bool`   |          |
| `--no-wait`       | `bool`   |          |

```sh
greennode volume detach-volume --volume-id <volume-id> --server-id <server-id> --yes
```

## list-all-snapshots

Kind: Read.

Visits up to 50 pages per inventory. Conflicting or incomplete pages fail
without an aggregate.

No fields.

```sh
greennode volume list-all-snapshots
```

Kind: Read.

No fields.

```sh

```

## list-snapshot-backends

Kind: Read.

Supported regions are `hcm-3` and `han-1`. Use `HCM-03` or `HAN-01` to find a
backend ID.

| Flag     | Type     | Required |
| -------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--name` | `string` | yes      |

```sh
greennode volume list-snapshot-backends --name <name>
```

## list-snapshot-policies

Kind: Read.

Use a backend ID from `list-snapshot-backends`. The default page is 1 and the
default size is 10.

| Flag           | Type     | Required |
| -------------- | -------- | -------- |
| `--backend-id` | `string` | yes      |
| `--page`       | `int`    |          |
| `--size`       | `int`    |          |

```sh
greennode volume list-snapshot-policies --backend-id <backend-id>
```

## list-volume-prices

Kind: Read.

An explicitly selected catalog zone can be quoted even when disabled. Size 0
uses each type’s minimum. Sizes outside the offering bounds remain inapplicable.

Use `--sort-by name`, `--sort-by monthly-price`, or `--sort-by unit-price` with
optional `--descending`. `--allow-partial` prints safe results and exits 1 when
discovery is incomplete.

| Flag               | Type     | Required |
| ------------------ | -------- | -------- |
| `--zone-id`        | `string` |          |
| `--volume-type-id` | `string` |          |
| `--iops`           | `int`    |          |
| `--size`           | `int`    |          |
| `--encryption`     | `string` |          |
| `--max-requests`   | `int`    |          |
| `--allow-partial`  | `bool`   |          |
| `--descending`     | `bool`   |          |
| `--sort-by`        | `string` |          |

```sh
greennode volume list-volume-prices
```

## quote-create-volume

Kind: Read.

Quotes without ordering. `--name` and `--auto-renew` do not affect the quote.

| Flag                                     | Type      | Required |
| ---------------------------------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--name`                                 | `string`  |          |
| `--zone-id`                              | `string`  | yes      |
| `--size`                                 | `int`     | yes      |
| `--volume-type-id`                       | `string`  | yes      |
| `--encryption-type-id`                   | `string`  |          |
| `--auto-renew`                           | `bool`    |          |
| `MaxPrice` (via `--cli-input-json` only) | `float64` |          |
| `NoWait` (via `--cli-input-json` only)   | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode volume quote-create-volume --zone-id <zone-id> --size <size> --volume-type-id <volume-type-id>
```

## resize-volume

Kind: Write, destructive.

Requires `--yes`. The requested size must exceed the current size and the quote
must be positive and at most `--max-price`.

Use `get-volume` to check an uncertain outcome. Grow the filesystem separately
after the block device settles.

| Flag          | Type      | Required |
| ------------- | --------- | -------- |
| `--volume-id` | `string`  | yes      |
| `--size`      | `int`     | yes      |
| `--max-price` | `float64` |          |
| `--no-wait`   | `bool`    |          |

```sh
greennode volume resize-volume --volume-id <volume-id> --size <size> --yes
```
